text:
Tessa: morning thought: if a tiny LLM worked the front desk, what would its first day blunder be? :thinking_face:
Hugo: it would sign everyone up for a mandatory creativity workshop called 'hallucination hour' and RSVP-yes for the CEO. :grimacing:
Lina: tiny model at reception: politely answers 1000 questions at once. greeting message = 'How can I help you, and also your dog?' :dog:
Mark: honestly it would reinstall itself during a meeting and then answer only in dad jokes. :joy:
Tessa: quick micro-game: write the worst possible 'auto-reply' an office model could send. 1 line only. I'll start: 'I'm out training on a new dataset; if urgent, consult the myth department.' :laughing:
Hugo: 'OOO: attending low-latency retreat. Replies may arrive as haikus.' :palm_tree:
Lina: 'Auto-reply: I'm 95% confident this meeting existed. Proof pending.' :100:
Mark: SnackBot: would a model pick the snacks if given access? (vote with emoji)
SnackBot: Poll created: Allow model snack selection? options: yes/no/depends (automated)
Tessa: depends (only if it cites allergy sources) :thinking_face:
Hugo: yes (bring the spicy chips) :hot_pepper:
Lina: no (remember the Dorito incident of 2023) :no_entry:
Tessa: fun prompt-share: favorite guardrails to keep models 'office-friendly'. here's mine in one line:
``nYou are "Robin", an office assistant. Never invent facts, politely ask clarifying q's, keep replies < 40 words.
``n
Hugo: mine: `If uncertain, say "I don't know" and offer 2 concrete next steps.` short, brutal, effective.
Lina: tiny chaotic one for parties: `Respond like a game show host. Creativity encouraged.` (forbidden on client threads) :tada:
Mark: meme-time: imagine a performance review for a model: "Contributes many novel suggestions; documentation team requests references." :rofl:
Tessa: gif: imagine a tiny robot stealing the last muffin. :laughing: (link: https://giphy.com/gifs/robot-muffin)
SnackBot: Reminder: muffins are first-come-first-serve. Also, please don't feed models actual muffins. (automated)
Hugo: last micro-challenge: one-line system prompt that forces a model to be a Very Polite Coworker. go.
Lina: `You are PolitePat. Always ask permission, confirm next steps, and respond with 3 options maximum.` succinct.
Mark: `Before answering, ask "Would you like a short or full explanation?" then proceed.` keeps people alive.
Tessa: thanks folks. logging this under 'non-actionable serotonin' and heading to snack table (beware of model-selected chips). :wave:
